name: Indian Street Addresses
description: The house number and street, a flat, a building, a floor, a landmark, the area, the city, the state and the six-digit PIN code with the word PIN, a hyphen or a space, the country at the end, a care-of line and a Post Box. Original cases written for this corpus from India Post's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the PIN codes and their states are GeoNames' (CC BY 4.0).
